wallpapers.name: 蔚蓝地平线
wallpapers.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: premium high-definition space wallpaper for Norma OS, a macOS infinite canvas workspace with floating terminal cards.
Output: one complete landscape wallpaper, wide 16:9 composition, target 3840 x 2160 pixels at the highest available native resolution. Full bleed image only.
Art direction: sophisticated cinematic astrophotography blended with exquisite physically based space art. Awe, silence, enormous scale. Carefully composed visual hierarchy with broad quiet regions for floating workspace windows; nuanced near-black shadows with visible tonal depth. Crisp celestial edges and natural small-scale texture, impeccably smooth atmospheric gradients. Beautiful enough to stand alone at desktop scale.
Constraints: absolutely no text, lettering, logos, watermarks, UI, borders, frame, collage, panel grid, spaceship, astronaut, buildings, or excessive lens flares. Avoid star confetti, excessive neon saturation, over-sharpening, and crushed blacks.
Scene: a serene orbital dawn above a large Earthlike ocean planet. Only the curved upper limb of the planet rises from the lower quarter of the image; the sphere itself extends beyond the bottom edge. Very fine sculpted white cloud systems and inky ocean on its shadowed surface, a razor-thin electric sapphire and pale cyan atmospheric rim. A single distant sun is concealed just beyond the right edge, lending a delicate pearl-blue illumination to the curve without a glaring orb. Upper two-thirds are deep midnight blue empty space with very sparse tiny pin-sharp stars and almost imperceptible atmospheric haze. One graceful uninterrupted planetary curve as the main gesture, no other planets. Elegant restrained palette: ink blue, cobalt, glacial cyan and ivory. Quiet and expansive, premium flagship operating-system wallpaper, extraordinary realistic material detail along the lower edge.

Scene: an immense dark ringed planet in the right third of a charcoal-black cosmos. The planet is mostly in velvety shadow, spherical surface in muted brown-black with subtle realistic cloud bands and a delicate warm ivory crescent edge. Its paper-thin orbital rings form one elegant broad diagonal ellipse from lower left toward upper right, passing convincingly in front of and behind the sphere, with delicate parallel dust grooves and soft champagne-gold backlighting. The ring plane is tilted about 22 degrees; it sweeps gracefully beyond the image boundaries. Left half stays dark and open, very sparse stars. Soft physically plausible reflected ringlight, nuanced black and warm graphite shadows, refined antique gold, brushed champagne, pale cream. Understated cinematic grandeur, not a bright explosive sci-fi poster; geometrically clean, exceptionally fine ring texture.

Scene: a luminous interstellar nebula viewed at enormous distance, a single flowing sculptural ribbon of translucent violet and indigo cosmic gas drifting through a vast ink-black starfield. The gas curls from lower-left edge through the lower middle and rises toward the upper-right edge, shaped by organic turbulent filaments and delicate wisps, with very fine Hubble-like astrophotographic dust texture. A subtle pale lavender inner glow suggests hidden newborn stars; highlights are restrained, never blown out. Broad central-upper and left-upper negative space remains deep night violet. Scene: orbital view of the night side of a distant cold ocean planet. A dramatically long shallow planetary arc spans only the bottom fifth, dark glacial clouds and subtle cloud-top texture on its surface, no visible city lights. An ethereal emerald aurora traces the curve above the atmosphere, softly folding into several elegant translucent vertical curtains that taper into deep space.
